title: Debounced saver POSTs to a route the spec pins as PUT; only the beacon needs POST
detail: Spec pins `PUT /apply/:code/draft` twice; saveNow (not the beacon) uses POST with no in-chunk justification. Saves fail silently by design, so if router/middleware arms are PUT-only the whole feature no-ops invisibly.
recommended_fix: Use PUT in saveNow's fetch (keep POST only for the sendBeacon flush), or correct the spec to state the draft route is POST/PUT dual-method.

title: validEmail comment and test name claim near-miss emails still save, but the code gates the save on them
detail: currentPayload returns null when validEmail fails, so a rejected near-miss (e.g. "tenant@example") gates the save locally — the opposite of what both the comment and the test name state. Behavior matches the spec; the prose contradicts it.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment and test name to say locally-implausible emails block the save ("invalid/missing email → no save" per the spec matrix).

title: Spec frontmatter declares status 'done' while its Tests task remains unchecked
evidence:
status: 'done'
---
- [ ] Tests — JS: `scripts/js-tests/form_draft.test.js` (serializer/debounce/beacon/copy-swap), extend `form_stepper.test.js` + `apply_analytics.test.js`; server unit: email builders, field filter, middleware/body-size arms; integration: `server/test/integration/draft_integration_test.gleam` (round-trip, resume-once, strip-on-submit, expiry sweep, erasure, unique key)
detail: Every other task in the same spec is `[x]`; the Tests line is `[ ]` while the document asserts the feature is done and acceptance requires green test runs. Either the checkbox is stale or the status is premature.
recommended_fix: Flip the Tests checkbox to [x] if the suites are complete, or drop status back to in-progress until they are.

title: Cross-file DOM event-name contract is test-pinned on only one side
detail: form_draft.test.js never asserts draft.EVENT_DRAFT_SAVED or draft.EVENT_STEP_CHANGED. If the emitter's string drifts from the listener's, the analytics relay (and the save hook) break silently with no failing test.
recommended_fix: Add assertions in form_draft.test.js pinning draft.EVENT_DRAFT_SAVED === "rt:draft-saved" and draft.EVENT_STEP_CHANGED === "rt:form-step-changed".

title: No fetch capability check despite 'capability is real' copy-swap promise; sendBeacon and CustomEvent are guarded, fetch is not
detail: On a fetch-less browser the prep note is swapped to the save-and-continue promise and the button injected, but saveNow and the click handler throw synchronously (no promise chain, so .catch never runs). Contradicts the file's progressive-enhancement header.
recommended_fix: Add `if (typeof root.fetch !== "function") return;` to initBrowser before the copy swap and button injection.
